description: Client-side script for managing the 'Production Plan' form in ERPNext, including setup, refresh, button actions, and related item handling.

methods.name: close_open_production_plan
methods.description: Sets the production plan status to open or closed via server call.

methods.name: make_work_order
methods.description: Triggers server call to create a work order for the production plan.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Confirms and triggers creation of a material request.

methods.name: create_material_request
methods.description: Calls server to create or submit a material request based on parameter.

methods.name: get_sales_orders
methods.description: Fetches open sales orders related to the production plan.

methods.name: get_material_request
methods.description: Fetches pending material requests related to the production plan.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches items for the production plan.

methods.name: combine_items
methods.description: Fetches and combines items, including sub-assembly items.

methods.name: get_sub_assembly_items
methods.description: Fetches sub-assembly items for the production plan.

methods.name: get_items_for_mr
methods.description: Prepares and fetches items for material requests, with optional warehouse selection.

methods.name: download_materials_required
methods.description: Opens a dialog to select warehouses and downloads raw materials data.

methods.name: show_progress
methods.description: Displays production progress dashboard with item quantities.
